diabetes_mellitus.why: Common comorbidity associated with longer operative time and positive residual correlation.

hypertension.why: Marker of medical complexity; positively correlated with longer-than-predicted duration.

renal_insufficiency_or_ckd.why: Renal disease/comorbidity likely adds perioperative complexity and time.

coronary_artery_disease.why: Cardiovascular comorbidity associated with more complex cases and longer duration.

adhesions.why: Adhesions often prolong dissection and operative time.

blood_loss_ml.why: Higher blood loss is a direct marker of longer, more difficult operations.

laparoscopic_or_robotic.why: Minimally invasive approach can indicate additional setup/technical steps and correlates with residual time.

hysterectomy.why: Specific gynecologic extent/procedure type that may capture duration not explained by specialty alone.
